pilotDescription: Scan attach for one org. The meter is SKU seats, not credits. Guard and SIEM are separate products — do not bundle.
pilotStepOrg: Confirm this workspace is the hotel or company (one org, not nested properties).
pilotStepInvite: Invite IT as owner/admin and GM as viewer if they only need reports.
pilotStepAssets: Name 1–3 assets at first. Raise caps only after renewal works.
pilotStepSchedules: Enable a schedule — monthly or weekly depends on the active tier. Notify on new critical/high.
pilotStepReport: Send the Bahasa executive HTML. Hybrid review is 5 business days, not 24/7 SOC.
